    Steps

    3. Choose a server in the app and connect.

    Import into v2rayN

    Copy the subscription below, then follow these steps in v2rayN.

    1. Open Subscription groups → Subscription group settings.
    2. Add a group, paste the URL, and save.
    3. Update the subscription, then choose a server.

    For a one-time import, use “Copy all” under Configurations, then import URLs from the clipboard in v2rayN (Ctrl+V on Windows).
